notes.title: New Christmas Game
notes.content:
Ho-ho-ho, gamers!
Christmas is here! 
"Where the treetops glisten"

Just check out our new Christmas themed Game and  Bundle:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490790/Christmas_Adventures_A_Winter_Nights_Dream/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18447/Christmas_Adventures_Bundle/
[b]Merry Christmas and Happy New Year![/b]
